posts.text: Bad legal news for Trump: a federal court has rejected the DOJ request to use a grand jury subpoena to obtain the names and addresses of virtually anyone involved in the 2020 Fulton County election.  The judge decided that the subpoena was overly broad and could not lead to any criminal charge, since the statute of limitations had passed.
